20619-general-gordon-saint-and-soldier.title: Saint And Soldier.
20619-general-gordon-saint-and-soldier.creator: J. Wardle, C.C.,
20619-general-gordon-saint-and-soldier.description: A book by J. Wardle, C.C.,. It has been said that the most interesting study for mankind is man; and surely one of the grandest objects for human contemplation, is a noble character; a lofty type of a truly great and good man is humanity's richest heritage.

a-short-history-of-english-agriculture.title: A Short History of English Agriculture
a-short-history-of-english-agriculture.creator: W. H. R. (William Henry Ricketts) Curtler

arxiv-2011-10409.title: A criterion for the existence of logarithmic connections on curves over a perfect field
arxiv-2011-10409.creator: S. Manikandan, Anoop Singh
arxiv-2011-10409.description: Abstract . Let k k be a perfect field, and X X an irreducible smooth projective curve over k k . We give a criterion for a vector bundle over X X to admit a logarithmic connection singular over a finite subset of X X with given residues, where residues are assumed to be rigid.

arxiv-2012-14514.title: Adiabatic Quantum Algorithm for Multijet Clustering in High Energy Physics
arxiv-2012-14514.creator: Diogo Pires, Yasser Omar, João Seixas
arxiv-2012-14514.description: Abstract The currently predicted increase in computational demand for the upcoming High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) event reconstruction, and in particular jet clustering, is bound to challenge present day computing resources, becoming an even more complex combinatorial problem. In this paper, we show that quantum annealing can tackle dijet event clustering by introducing a novel quantum annealing binary clustering algorithm.

arxiv-2101-10708.title: Few-Shot Semantic Parsing for New Predicates
arxiv-2101-10708.creator: Zhuang Li, Lizhen Qu, Shuo Huang, Gholamreza Haffari
arxiv-2101-10708.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the problems of semantic parsing in a few-shot learning setting. In this setting, we are provided with k k utterance-logical form pairs per new predicate. The state-of-the-art neural semantic parsers achieve less than 25% accuracy on benchmark datasets when k = 1 k=1 .

arxiv-2104-02650.title: Model-data-driven Constitutive Responses: Application to a Multiscale Computational Framework
arxiv-2104-02650.creator: Jan Niklas Fuhg, Christoph Böhm, Nikolaos Bouklas, Amélie Fau, Peter Wriggers, Michele Marino
arxiv-2104-02650.description: Abstract Computational multiscale methods for analyzing and deriving constitutive responses have been used as a tool in engineering problems because of their ability to combine information at different length scales. However, their application in a nonlinear framework can be limited by high computational costs, numerical difficulties, and/or inaccuracies.

arxiv-2109-05566.title: PQ-Transformer: Jointly Parsing 3D Objects and Layouts from Point Clouds
arxiv-2109-05566.creator: Xiaoxue Chen, Hao Zhao, Guyue Zhou, Ya-Qin Zhang
arxiv-2109-05566.description: Abstract 3D scene understanding from point clouds plays a vital role for various robotic applications. Unfortunately, current state-of-the-art methods use separate neural networks for different tasks like object detection or room layout estimation. Such a scheme has two limitations: 1) Storing and running several networks for different tasks are expensive for typical robotic platforms.

arxiv-2109-11031.title: Using the Carnot cycle to determine changes of the phase transition temperature
arxiv-2109-11031.creator: Oskar Grocholski, Kornel Howil, Stanisław Rakowski, Piotr Maksymiuk
arxiv-2109-11031.description: Abstract The Clausius-Clapeyron relation and its analogs in other first-order phase transitions, such as type-I superconductors, are derived using very elementary methods, without appealing to the more advanced concepts of entropy or Gibbs free energy. The reasoning is based on Kelvin’s formulation of the second law of thermodynamics, and should be accessible to high school students.

arxiv-2208-00787.title: On the robustness of self-supervised representations for multi-view object classification
arxiv-2208-00787.creator: David Torpey, Richard Klein
arxiv-2208-00787.description: Abstract It is known that representations from self-supervised pre-training can perform on par, and often better, on various downstream tasks than representations from fully-supervised pre-training. This has been shown in a host of settings such as generic object classification and detection, semantic segmentation, and image retrieval.

arxiv-2306-14756.title: Facilitation of controllable excitation in Rydberg atomic ensembles Thanks: The National Science Foundation of China (Grants No. 12174106, No. 11474094), and the Science and Technology Commission of Shanghai Municipality (Grant No. 18ZR1412800).
arxiv-2306-14756.creator: Han Wang, Jing Qian State Key Laboratory of Precision Spectroscopy, Department of Physics, School of Physics and Electronic Science, East China Normal University, Shanghai 200062, China
arxiv-2306-14756.description: Abstract Strongly-interacting Rydberg atomic ensembles have shown intense collective excitation effects due to the inclusion of single Rydberg excitation shared by multiple atoms in the ensemble. In this paper we investigate a counter-intuitive Rydberg excitation facilitation with a strongly-interacting atomic ensemble in the strong probe-field regime, which is enabled by the role of a control atom nearby.

arxiv-2308-14071.title: Supporting Passive Users in mmWave Networks Thanks: The research carried out at UCLA was supported in part by the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) awards ECCS-2229560 and CNS-2146838 . The work of M. Cardone was supported in part by the NSF under Grants CCF-2045237 and CNS-2146838 .
arxiv-2308-14071.creator: Mine Gokce Dogan, Martina Cardone, Christina Fragouli
arxiv-2308-14071.description: Abstract The interference from active to passive users is a well-recognized challenge in millimeter-wave (mmWave) communications. We propose a method that enables to limit the interference on passive users (whose presence may not be detected since they do not transmit) with a small penalty to the throughput of active users.

arxiv-2309-11482.title: X-rays Trace the Volatile Content of Interstellar Objects
arxiv-2309-11482.creator: Samuel H. C. Cabot, Q. Daniel Wang, Darryl Z. Seligman
arxiv-2309-11482.description: Abstract The non-detection of a coma surrounding 1I/‘Oumuamua, the first discovered interstellar object (ISO), has prompted a variety of hypotheses to explain its nongravitational acceleration. Given that forthcoming surveys are poised to identify analogues of this enigmatic object, it is prudent to devise alternative approaches to characterization.

arxiv-2510-01362.title: EvoStruggle: A Dataset Capturing the Evolution of Struggle across Activities and Skill Levels
arxiv-2510-01362.creator: Shijia Feng, Michael Wray, Walterio Mayol-Cuevas
arxiv-2510-01362.description: Abstract The ability to determine when a person struggles during skill acquisition is crucial for both optimizing human learning and enabling the development of effective assistive systems. As skills develop, the type and frequency of struggles tend to change, and understanding this evolution is key to determining the user’s current stage of learning.

arxiv-2603-10842.title: PivotAttack: Rethinking the Search Trajectory in Hard-Label Text Attacks via Pivot Words
arxiv-2603-10842.creator: Yuzhi Liang, Shiliang Xiao, Jingsong Wei, Qiliang LinXia LiGuangdong University of Foreign Studies, China yzliang@gdufs.edu.cn, silan2499776755@163.com, 1056111087@qq.com2043664242@qq.com, xiali@gdufs.edu.cn

pmc-10714626.title: Maternal and neonatal complications after IVF/ICSI-fresh embryo transfer in low-prognosis women under the POSEIDON criteria: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-10714626.creator: Shiguang Li, Huifang Tan, Huimin Fu, Juan Du, Peihao Liu, Yingying Qin
pmc-10714626.description: BackgroundSeveral studies on pregnancy complications of poor ovarian response (POR) patients did not draw a consistent conclusion. The POSEIDON criteria introduces the concept of “low prognosis” and divides POR patients into four groups based on age, AFC and AMH for individualized management.

pmc-11433852.title: A Comparison Analysis of Four Different Drying Treatments on the Volatile Organic Compounds of Gardenia Flowers
pmc-11433852.creator: Jiangli Peng, Wen Ai, Xinyi Yin, Dan Huang, Shunxiang Li, John A Beutler
pmc-11433852.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The gardenia flower not only has extremely high ornamental value but also is an important source of natural food and spices, with a wide range of uses. To support the development of gardenia flower products, this study used headspace gas chromatography–ion mobility spectrometry (HS-GC–IMS) technology to compare and analyze the volatile organic compounds (VOCs) of fresh gardenia flower and those after using four different drying methods (vacuum freeze-drying (VFD), microwave drying (MD), hot-air drying (HAD), and vacuum drying (VD)).

pmc-11492938.title: Embedding the ‘CoolCuddle’ intervention for infants undergoing therapeutic hypothermia for hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy in NICU: an evaluation using normalisation process theory
pmc-11492938.creator: Lucy Beasant, Ela Chakkarapani, Jeremy Horwood, David Odd, Stephanie Stocks, Denise Parker, Jenny Ingram
pmc-11492938.description: ObjectivesNewborn infants exposed to lack of oxygen and blood flow to the brain around birth may develop brain dysfunction (hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy—HIE). These infants undergo 72 hours of cooling therapy and most are not held by their parents in the UK.

pmc-11710191.title: NLRP3 genetic polymorphisms are associated with the onset of mild cognitive impairment in Chinese
pmc-11710191.creator: Ruonan Gao, Suk Ling Ma
pmc-11710191.description: BackgroundNucleotide‐binding domain and leucine‐rich repeat (LRR)‐containing family protein 3 (NLRP3) is involved in neuroinflammation in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD). Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the NLRP3 gene are associated with the risk of AD in different populations, however the relationship between NLRP3 SNPs and Hong Kong population has not been studied.

pmc-12603836.title: Identification of molecular subtypes and prognostic risk model of glucocorticoid-related lncRNAs in bladder cancer to evaluate prognosis and immunological characteristics
pmc-12603836.creator: Liangliang Yu, Song Gao, Dan Li, Xuedong Chen
pmc-12603836.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundBladder cancer (BC) heterogeneity presents significant challenges in prognosis and personalized therapy. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) have been increasingly considered to be critical regulatory elements in tumor biology, and glucocorticoids exert complex effects on tumor biology. This investigation aimed to recognize glucocorticoid-related lncRNAs (GR-lncRNAs) and construct a prognostic signature for BC, elucidating their roles in subtype identification, prognosis, and immune characteristics.MethodsWe retrieved messenger RNA (mRNA) expression profiles, mutation information, and clinical data for BC from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) repository.

pmc-12606750.title: Desmoplastic Fibromas of the Bone: A Systematic Review of Clinical Presentation and Surgical Treatment
pmc-12606750.creator: Edoardo Ipponi, Francesco Pecchia, Sahar Toumie, Antonio D′Arienzo, Paolo Domenico Parchi, Lorenzo Andreani
pmc-12606750.description: Simple SummaryDesmoplastic fibroma is a rare, benign, but locally aggressive bone tumor. First described in 1958, to date, only a limited number of cases are available, and little is known about the clinical presentation and outcomes of surgical treatment. Our review included 187 cases of desmoplastic fibroma treated with surgery.

pmc-12619413.title: Olutasidenib for mutated IDH1 acute myeloid leukemia: final five-year results from the phase 2 pivotal cohort
pmc-12619413.creator: Jorge Cortes, Antonio Curti, Pierre Fenaux, Brian A Jonas, Jürgen Krauter, Pau Montesinos, Christian Récher, David C Taussig, Eunice S Wang, Justin Watts, Andrew Wei, Karen WL Yee, Hua Tian, Aaron Sheppard, Christophe Marzac, Stephane de Botton
pmc-12619413.description: BackgroundOlutasidenib is an oral, selective inhibitor of mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 (mIDH1), FDA-approved for relapsed/refractory (R/R) acute myeloid leukemia (AML) based on a registrational, phase 2, open-label, multicenter trial.MethodsResults from the pre-planned interim analysis were previously published (data cut-off [DCO]: June 2021).

pmc-12785640.title: Optimization of the Contrast Concentration for Low-Tube-Voltage Chest CT: A Randomized Controlled Trial with Low-Concentration Contrast Media
pmc-12785640.creator: Jiho Park, Bo Mi Gil, Yun-Hyeon Kim, Gong Yong Jin, Yeon Joo Jeong, Jin Mo Goo, Suyon Chang, Kyongmin Sarah Beck, Jung Im Jung
pmc-12785640.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objective: To evaluate the effect of low-concentration contrast media (LCCMs) on 100 kVp conventional chest CT by comparing the proportions of acceptable-quality scans obtained using various CM concentrations with those obtained using the standard protocol. Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trial enrolled adult patients with BMI < 30 who underwent enhanced chest CT between December 2023 and September 2024.

pmc-12874977.title: Clarity and consistency in government-funded implementation strategies associated with greater evidence-based practice reach: a mixed-method comparative case study
pmc-12874977.creator: Matthew Lee, Sarah B Hunter, Baji Tumendemberel, Mekdes Shiferaw, Mark D Godley, Jonathan Purtle, Gregory A Aarons, Alex R Dopp
pmc-12874977.description: BackgroundPolicymakers need research-informed guidance on leveraging national government funding to promote evidence-based practice (EBP) implementation, however empirical studies of policy financing strategies in implementation science remain limited. Major investments are already being made. Starting in 2012, the U.S. Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) funded state substance use service agencies to implement EBPs for youth substance use.

pmc-12971919.title: Emergency trauma admissions in the oldest-old: short- and long-term mortality and the role of frailty in a Turkish national cohort of centenarians
pmc-12971919.creator: Merve Güner, Yavuz Şahbat, Sinem Bayram, Serdar Ceylan, Rıfat Bozkuş, Naim Ata, Mustafa Cankurtaran, Şuayip Birinci
pmc-12971919.description: IntroductionThis study aimed to evaluate the impact of orthopedic trauma on mortality among centenarians presenting to the emergency department, to examine the relationship between frailty and longevity, and to provide insights into post-trauma survival in long-lived individuals, as well as the role of frailty mechanisms.MethodsData were retrieved from the National Personal Health Record System (NPHRS) of Türkiye.

pmc-13632169.title: Scalp trichilemmal cysts and headache: a correlation with tension-type headache features in an adult female patient—a case report
pmc-13632169.creator: Yazan AlHabil, Hamzeh Yacoub, Seema Hameedi, Khalil Sabbah, Zaid Yacoub, Khaled Nasrallah
pmc-13632169.description: IntroductionTension-type headaches (TTH) are prevalent primary headache disorders, affecting approximately 42% of the global population. Characterized by mild to moderate bilateral head pain, TTHs lack symptoms like photophobia and nausea (unless sometimes chronic TTH), distinguishing them from other headaches. They impose significant personal and societal burdens, particularly in high-income countries. Pathophysiology involves genetic factors, myofascial processes, and central sensitization.

pmc-13670651.title: Prognostic role of the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio in pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma: insights from a 20-year single-center experience
pmc-13670651.creator: Alper Uygun, Ayhan Dağdemir, İbrahim Kartal, Oğuz Salih Dinçer, Hülya Kangal Şimşek, Merve Ecem Öğretici Çolak, Gamzenur Yalçınkaya
pmc-13670651.description: IntroductionThe neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) is an established prognostic marker in adult malignancies, including Hodgkin lymphoma (HL). However, its clinical significance in pediatric HL remains uncertain due to biological differences and generally favorable outcomes. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of the diagnostic NLR in predicting relapse, refractory disease, and mortality in children with HL.
